profile.headline: Software Engineer at T-Mobile
profile.summary:
Multi-talented, young Software Engineer with a self-starter attitude. Led startup development team through multiple mobile and web projects. Experience with ETL and backend development for enterprise level systems.

Proficient in: Golang |  SQL | CI | ETL | Docker | API Development | Ethereum | Blockchain
Experience with: C++ | C | C # | Python | JS | Solidity | Kafka | Unity | AR | GCP | Firebase                                                                                                                                          

Github Link: https://github.com/DavidLeeR

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
-Work with backend of T-Mobile network monitoring applications
-Regularly communicate with managers, front end engineers, and back end engineers to determine project requirements
-Develop and maintain Golang and Python code for extract-transform-load (ETL) pipeline for products and services across entire T-Mobile network
-Develop and maintain APIs using Golang for accessing performance data for products across the entire T-Mobile network
-Develop and maintain Golang code for automated processes that assess products and services across the entire T-Mobile network
-Develop comprehensive testing for all development
-Work with enterprise-level databases containing millions of entries
-Work with multiple SQL databases such as MariaDB, Vertica, and Sybase
-Develop code using git and continuous integration (CI) collaboratively with other engineers
-Deploy code bases in Docker containers for application environment standardization
-Create detailed methods of procedure (MOP) documents for deployment and modification of code bases
-Host and monitor deployed production code in a Linux environment
-Develop performance tests in Python for Icinga network monitoring system
-Analyze, debug, and update legacy systems written in arbitrary coding languages

positions.description:
Responsibilities
-Led small development team (2 - 4 junior developers) through 3 mobile development projects in total
-Designed and wrote all code for augmented reality creation tool application (Wonderly App) using
Unity, Google Cloud Endpoints, Google Cloud Datastore (noSQL), and Firebase authentication
-Led small development team through creating the mobile AR application Dragon's Den, which was
featured on season 1 episode 2 of the HGTV show "Theme Queen"
-Designed and wrote all code for application back-end API (over 30 endpoints) for volunteer hub mobile
application (connectED) using Python, Google Cloud Platform, and Firebase Authentication
-Designed and wrote all code for noSQL database for volunteer hub mobile application (connectED)
using Python and Google Cloud Datastore
-Performed research and development with public key cryptography, digital signatures, and bitcoin
cryptography C library
-Designed system for digital content verification on the Ethereum blockchain

positions.title: Co-Founder/Blockchain Developer
positions.description:
CurrentC is an early stage blockchain solutions startup focusing on recording wholesale energy trading on the Ethereum network. In its simplest terms, “energy trading” is the buying, selling and moving of bulk energy (electricity and natural gas) from where it is produced to where it is needed.

Responsibilities:
-Designed energy trading decentralized app (demo) on Ethereum
-Wrote all code for energy trading energy trading app (demo)
-Researched blockchain applications in energy trading
-Researched use of permissioned blockchain in energy trading

Energy Trading Platform Smart Contracts:
https://github.com/DavidLeeR/CCC-kontracts

Energy Trading Platform Interface:
https://github.com/DavidLeeR/CCC-Interface

positions.description:
Responsibilities:
-Operated an ambulance under emergency and non-emergency conditions
-Operated in a major metropolitan area
-Provided pre-hospital emergency medical care under emergency and non-emergency conditions

positions.title: Undergraduate Cancer and Stem Cell Researcher
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
-Collaborated with research scientists on various novel  biomedical research projects, with a focus on human glioblastoma multiforme gene characterization
-Maintained cell line of human glioblastoma cancer cells
-Performed Minipreparation of plasmid DNA
-Performed Gel electrophoresis to test for presence of target DNA segments
-Performed RNA isolation of human globlastoma cancer cells
-Performed polymerase chain reaction (PCR) to amplify target DNA segments
-Performed data collection and analysis
-Scientific report writing

honors.title: Recognition
honors.description: Lee Ramirez is being recognized for his work enhancing the auto-incident closure process. Throughout the team's interaction with the transport NOC an opportunity for auto-closing additional power tickets was identified and Lee was tasked with developing the enhancements. His recent efforts have led to 381 incidents being closed in the 7 days since the feature was enabled on 2/21/2022.

patents.title: System and method for verifying the no-later-than date-of-existence, data integrity, identity of the recorder, and timestamp of the recording for digital content
patents.description: A system and method for recording and verifying the data integrity, identity of the recorder, and no-later-than date-of-existence for digital content of an arbitrary size is provided. The provided system and method employ blockchain technology to ensure immutability and accessibility of digital content state, digital content recorder identity, and timestamp of recording for the recorded digital content. The provided system and method also generate meta-data files associated with the recorded digital content that consist of a manifest file, a signature file, and a signature block file. The meta-data files are included into the digital content in order to facilitate the verification of the digital content against the records held in the blockchain.
